notes.title: Early Quest First Edition
notes.content:
Hello everyone, old and new users.

I'm here today to announce the release of the new Early Quest: Early Quest First Edition!

This pack includes the base game and all additional content released during this first year!

I hope that many players will take the opportunity to recover what they have lost, and also along with the anniversary discounts to complete their collection!

notes.title: First anniversary discount!
notes.content:
On the occasion of the first anniversary, get hold of all the contents!

The base game, soundtrack and all DLCs will be on sale for one week starting September 24!

Take the opportunity to recover what you have lost!

The "Early Quest First Edition" package will also be launched on the market, which includes all content in one edition!

notes.content:
I announce the release of the second DLC today!

In this new experience you will explore a new archipelago where you will have to deal with dragons and, of course, chickens!

There will also be mini-games where you can win fantastic prizes (including cash!)

The release date is ... March 4th? Who knows ...

notes.title: DLC 1 out!
notes.content:
And this is how I communicate the release of the first dlc in the store!

Look for the doors that were previously closed!

I take this opportunity to say a few words. The final end-game story update was also due today, but I decided not to release it. I'm preparing something really big and there are more issues to solve than expected, but I'm doing everything to release it as soon as possible. I apologize to everyone!

In any case there are new additions preparing the update, I hope you will look for them for the map! (But look, a mural in the old city ...)

I also take this opportunity to wish happy holidays to everyone!

notes.title: Early Quest
notes.content:
Hello to all,

Here we are at the update appointment.

Today many new enemies,
new characters,
new events,
many other minor fixes and additions.

I announce the release of the first DLC (and maybe the second as well? We will find out only by fighting) for December 24th!
The first DLC will deal with the history of magic outside of what is seen in the game, so I hope you enjoy it.

Regarding the "Now and in the Future" series of updates, I would like to announce that the next and last one will be released on December 24th!
With this we will close the chapter and end the end-game story, which I hope will shed some light on some things that remained unsolved in the main plot. Notice right now that it will be the biggest update to date, so get ready!

See you next time, appointment in 2 weeks!

I close by hoping that you continue to enjoy playing, and thank you!

A new enemy, difficult to meet, which will make many happy!
If you don't believe me, look for it in the mountain with the temple and let me know what you think!

For the rest:

New music

New secret zones and islands

New characters

New stories

And like last time:
New and correct history dialogues this time too
New event zones I talked about in the previous announcement
Lots of other minor fixes and additions.

As for the issue of the latest update, well, I'll add more stuff, so wait for news!

Also I take this opportunity to announce 2 DLCs. The first is just fun, pure and without fighting. The second is a lot of history ... ancient. I don't have a release period yet, but maybe sooner than you think ... we'll see!

That's it for now, see you next time!

I close by hoping that you continue to enjoy playing, and thank you!

He's still not sure he wants to take you to the archipelago, so if you ask him, he'll keep stealing your money (and even more than before).

notes.title: Early Quest
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you, I am very happy that I managed to finish this game.
Now, finishing is a big word, because in my head the things to do and add aren't finished.

Before talking about what's to come, however, I would like to thank the people who helped me in the creation process, because without them everything would have been very different (especially the testers who, to date, are fundamental for everything).

As for the future, I intend to correct some minor issues that have been pointed out to me, and this within a week of now. I will also take advantage of the update to add some secondary content, so I hope you like them.

The last thing, for now, is the presentation of the project at an event. As you progress through the game you will see that there is an event that goes on linearly and my intention is to release a new level every week for at least 4 weeks, so I hope you can return to the game by taking advantage of the new addition.

I have more surprises in store but, for now, I think I have said enough.

I close by hoping that you enjoy playing, and thank you!
